colour.normal: Mid to dark green from about V3; there is no single corn green. Chromaticity (each channel over the sum) removes most of the brightness difference between sunlit and shaded leaves; what remains varies with stage, stress, white balance and camera.

variants.name: Yellow-green seedlings
variants.appearance: Pale yellow-green until the nodal roots take over at about V3.

variants.name: Purple seedlings (cold, wet soil or phosphorus)
variants.appearance: Anthocyanin on the oldest leaves, usually gone by V6; persistent purple margins on new leaves point to phosphorus. Worked example ExGR about -0.14, below the vegetation cut: false skips in the row.

evidence.notes: The ExGR value is worked from an assumed colour ratio; it needs measuring on kept originals.

variants.name: Nitrogen deficiency
variants.appearance: V-shaped yellowing from the tip down the midrib of the oldest leaves; from above after V8 a paler canopy. Worked example ExGR about +0.15: usually stays in the green mask.

variants.name: Drought leaf rolling
variants.appearance: Leaves roll to thin lines at midday: less cover, more sunlit soil; thin leaves lost at coarse pixel sizes.

variants.name: Tassels
variants.appearance: Pale tassels on top of the canopy at VT to R1; below the vegetation cut, inside the cover mask.

variants.name: Senescence
variants.appearance: Yellow then brown from the lower leaves up at R5 to R6; the green mask empties.

indices.name: ExG + 0.5 × CIVE on chromaticity, Otsu per window (the app's photo and map pattern mask)
indices.formula: (2g - r - b) + 0.5 × -(0.441 r - 0.811 g + 0.385 b), r g b chromaticity
indices.thresholds: Otsu per window with a whole-photo fallback. On every corn and orchard photo tested the split sits at 0.20 to 0.34; on a red-soil no-till photo it fell to -0.20, between soil and straw.
indices.performance: ExG and CIVE are the least stable indices over a day in wheat (coefficient of variation 56% and 58% against 2% for ExGR; Qseg 0.617 and 0.65 against 0.776).

evidence.notes: Otsu always returns a split; when one class is missing (closed canopy, all soil) or the two classes are soil and straw, the split is not a plant/ground split.

indices.name: ExGR (ExG - ExR) at zero (the app's field-map vegetation mask)
indices.formula: (2g - r - b) - (1.4 r - g), chromaticity; equivalently 4g - 1.4r - 1
indices.thresholds: Fixed at 0 (Meyer and Neto 2008). Measured on our imagery: soil about -0.24, straw about -0.14, neutral grey -0.133; the cover mask cuts at -0.08.
indices.performance: Quality factor 0.88 ± 0.12 against 0.53 ± 0.39 for ExG with Otsu in greenhouse tests; both about 0.88 on field soybean; most stable over a day in wheat.

evidence.disagreement: A UAV maize seedling study (snippet) ranked ExG with Otsu best; platforms, stages and scoring differ.

illumination.name: Hard shadows
illumination.effect: Shadowed soil and leaves are misclassified; cover underestimated by up to 0.2 at peak growth; ExG is the worst affected. Shadow length = height / tan(sun elevation): a 30 cm V5 plant casts 17 cm at 60° and 52 cm at 30°; a 60 cm V8 plant at 30° spans a 76 cm alley.
illumination.guidance: Fly in diffuse light (overcast or early morning) or within about two hours of solar noon; treat cells whose deep-shadow share exceeds the limit as not assessed.

illumination.name: Glint, hotspot, wet leaves
illumination.effect: Near-saturated colourless highlights drop out of the mask and leave holes in leaves; the hotspot sits opposite the sun.

illumination.name: White-balance drift between frames
illumination.effect: A shift of 0.02 in green chromaticity moves ExGR by 0.08 (our arithmetic): enough to push soil or straw over the cover cut. Orthomosaic colour balancing can do the same across seams.
illumination.guidance: Compare each frame's soil index with the field median; lock white balance when flying.

backgrounds.name: Light, dry soil
backgrounds.appearance: Pale brown, slightly negative excess green.
backgrounds.effectOnIndex: Clean separation; Otsu at about 0.27 on the close-up corn photo.

backgrounds.name: Red, iron-rich soil (latossolo, terra rossa)
backgrounds.appearance: Strongly red; very negative excess green (about -0.4).
backgrounds.effectOnIndex: With bright straw present Otsu splits soil from straw (threshold about -0.20) and the 'vegetation' mask covers 79% of the photo.

evidence.notes: One photo; the cause is general (Otsu splits the two largest modes).

backgrounds.name: Wet or dark soil
backgrounds.appearance: Darker but its colour ratio barely changes; noisier; very wet soil can glint.
backgrounds.effectOnIndex: Little change in chromaticity indices; more noise in dark pixels.

backgrounds.name: Straw and stover residue
backgrounds.appearance: Bright, near-neutral, elongated; in no-till it forms stripes at the crop's own pitch, often offset from the new rows.
backgrounds.effectOnIndex: ExG with Otsu gives false positives on bright residue; ExGR at zero holds (straw about -0.14). Brightness profiles see the straw stripes as rows.

backgrounds.name: Algae or moss on wet soil
backgrounds.appearance: Smooth, spread-out green without plant shape.

orthomosaicArtefacts.name: Stitching failure over repetitive rows
orthomosaicArtefacts.effect: Misregistration, doubled or kinked rows, seams; rows break at seam lines.

orthomosaicArtefacts.name: Resampling and blending blur
orthomosaicArtefacts.effect: Maize stand counting R² 0.616 on mosaics against 0.906 on the original frames; holes and 'melted' seedlings in a WebODM mosaic. Measure plants in the original frames.

orthomosaicArtefacts.name: Wind or downdraft ghosting
orthomosaicArtefacts.effect: Blurred or doubled plants in the mosaic.

orthomosaicArtefacts.name: Relief displacement of tall corn
orthomosaicArtefacts.effect: d = D × h / (H - h): at 60 m above ground and 20 m from the frame centre a 2.5 m canopy leans 0.87 m, more than a 76 cm row; at V5 the lean is about 15 cm at 40 m.

failureConditions.condition: Hard shadows (low sun, from about V8)
failureConditions.effect: Shadowed ground and leaves misclassified; cover underestimated by up to 0.2.
Soil or straw crosses the cover cut.
failureConditions.detection: Frame soil index against the field median.

failureConditions.condition: Bright residue on dark or red soil
failureConditions.effect: The automatic vegetation split falls between soil and straw: most of the photo reads as vegetation, the green row fit fails and brightness puts the rows on the straw stripes.
failureConditions.detection: Otsu threshold below the index of grey (about zero); the profile's ExGR gate applies.

evidence.notes: Seen on one photo (0359, red soil with straw strips), reproduced on a rendered scene in the regression tests.

failureConditions.condition: Residue stripes at the crop's pitch
failureConditions.effect: A brightness row fit locks onto the straw, half a row off the crop.
failureConditions.detection: Green on the brightness lines against green half a pitch away.

failureConditions.condition: Crop coated in soil after heavy rain
failureConditions.effect: Crop reads as soil: false skips.
failureConditions.detection: Brown plant-shaped blobs in lattice gaps.

failureConditions.condition: Cold or phosphorus purpling at V2 to V5
failureConditions.effect: Purple seedlings fall below the green cut: false skips.
failureConditions.detection: Reddish blobs at lattice positions in season.

failureConditions.effect: Lower cover, thin leaves lost at coarse pixels.
Pale blobs on the canopy; green share drops.

failureConditions.condition: Canopy closure (about V10 in 30 in rows)
failureConditions.effect: No ground between rows; Otsu has one class; rows visible only from brightness.
failureConditions.detection: Vegetation share of the photo or cells at 0.85 or more.

failureConditions.effect: Doubled or kinked rows at seams.
failureConditions.detection: Rows break at seam lines; compare with the kept originals.

failureConditions.effect: Canopy leans into the alley away from the frame centre.
Position rules call them crop: missed.
failureConditions.detection: Not from colour at 1 cm or coarser; shape only at millimetre pixels.

failureConditions.condition: Grass weeds (johnsongrass, shattercane, foxtails, volunteer corn)
failureConditions.effect: Spectrally and in form like corn; in the row they are corn to every rule we have.
failureConditions.detection: Off-row position; patch persistence across seasons; late height.

failureConditions.effect: The row pattern weakens; weeds may be read as crop rows.
failureConditions.detection: Row coherence falls; cover exceeds what the crop alone gives at the stage.

failureConditions.effect: Stalks lie across rows; lattice broken.

failureConditions.condition: Mixed pixels at row edges at about 3 cm and coarser
failureConditions.effect: Crop edges read as weed; small weeds vanish.
failureConditions.detection: Pixel size against the profile's requirements.

failureConditions.effect: Thin leaves lose colour; colour bleeds at edges.

gaps: No full-text index accuracy comparison for maize; the best full-text comparison (Sadeghi-Tehran 2017) is wheat.
ExGR of corn stover and soybean stubble, the darkening of wet soil, the green-cover drop at tasselling or under leaf rolling: not found.
The ExGR values for purple, yellow, tassel and brown leaves are worked from assumed colour ratios and need measuring on kept originals.
Ghosting and stitching failure rates in corn, JPEG effects on ExGR, algae and standing water: not found.

The ExGR gate at zero rests on the literature (Meyer and Neto 2008) and our measured straw and soil values; purple seedlings fall below it and no field set with soil and residue labels has measured its cost.
